storage: Keep unwashed and dry in a paper bag in the fridge; wash only just before cooking.
looksLike: Slim, bright green, ridged pods about the length of a finger with a pointed tip and fine fuzz; cut open they show white seeds and a sticky sap.
howToPick: Small to medium pods that snap crisply at the tip, bright green, no black spots or shrivelling; avoid bendy, hard or sticky pods.
shelfLife: About 2 to 3 days in the fridge (dish 37 note: keep unwashed in a paper bag).

usedIn.raw: 200 g as bought per serving (about 185 g trimmed; 18–20 medium pods)
